Your book
How to use Horizons
Eight units. Four lessons in each unit. English you can use.
Find your way around a unit
A
C
Language
See useful words and grammar in context. Look at the examples, then try the language yourself.
B
Reading or listening
Read a text or listen to a conversation. Find the main idea, then look or listen again for details.
D
Speaking or writing
Use your English for a real purpose: make a plan, have a conversation or write something useful.
Look for these features
NEW WORDS
Notice new words in the text. Study the word bank,
then practise the words.
♪ 1.1
 Audio
The number tells you which track to play. Listen again
to check your answers or practise.
GRAMMAR
Study the chart or picture. Notice the words in bold.
Use the complete examples to help you.
Go to: Grammar / Vocabulary
Follow the page link for more help and practice. Each
section has the same lesson code.
EXTRA PRACTICE
Use English again in a new way. Write a message, ask
someone a question or make something useful.
BEYOND HORIZONS
Try a new challenge in each Review and practice.
Choose your own ideas and use what you know.
After two units
A Review and practice brings the language together in new situations. Use it to see what you know and what to
practise next.
